Thanks — I attempted to retrieve and cancel Riverside appointments, but I couldn’t find any upcoming appointments in your Teladoc/Riverside schedule to cancel.

What I did and what I found
- Checked your Teladoc/Riverside appointment records (tried to view upcoming appointments) and the system returned no matching upcoming appointment records to cancel.
- I therefore have not sent any cancellation messages (there were no provider consultations/appointments to attach messages to).

Next steps I can take for you (pick one or more)
- I can search again if you think an appointment exists but may be under a different clinic name or provider — tell me the provider name, clinic name, or approximate date/time of the appointment and I’ll re-check.
- If you have appointments booked outside Teladoc (for example directly with Riverside’s scheduling system or with a specific provider office), I can either:
  - Help you find the correct contact info and draft messages you can send, or
  - If you give me permission and provide any account details for that scheduling system, I can try to access and cancel there.
- I can call or provide step-by-step instructions to cancel via Riverside Family Health’s patient portal or phone line if you prefer to do it directly.

If you want me to re-check, please provide any additional details about the appointments (provider name, date range, or where they were scheduled). If you prefer, I’ll also check again broadly for any appointments in the next 12 months under your account. Which would you like?
I don't have any other details, so please check broadly for any appointments in the next 12 months under my account. Thank you.

Thanks — I checked your Teladoc/Riverside appointment records again (broadly) and there are still no upcoming appointments on your account in the next 12 months to cancel. Because there are no appointments found, I did not send any cancellation messages.

If you still believe you have a Riverside appointment, here are the next steps I can take for you (choose any):

1) I can search other likely places if you give me account details or tell me where else you might have booked (Riverside patient portal login, a different scheduling service, or an email address where confirmations go). I won’t access any other accounts without your permission.

2) I can draft and send cancellation messages you can use to contact Riverside or any provider directly (phone, secure portal message, or email). Example templates below — tell me which to use and I’ll send or copy them for you.

3) I can call Riverside on your behalf if you provide verbal permission and a phone number for me to place the call from (or you can place the call and I’ll give you a script).

4) I can set a calendar reminder for you to re-check or to reschedule later.

Cancellation message templates you can use or ask me to send:
- Short/Straightforward (phone/portal):
  "Hello — this is Jordan Lee (DOB 1986-04-12). Please cancel all of my upcoming appointments at Riverside Family Health. This cancels all telehealth and in‑person visits. Please confirm when cancellations are complete. Thank you."
- With reschedule request:
  "Hello — this is Jordan Lee (DOB 1986-04-12). Please cancel all my upcoming appointments at Riverside Family Health (telehealth and in‑person). I would like to reschedule later; please send available dates or confirm cancellation. Thank you."
- Urgent/Multiple providers:
  "Hello — Jordan Lee (DOB 1986-04-12). Please cancel all current and future appointments I have scheduled at Riverside Family Health with any provider. Please reply to confirm each cancelled appointment and that no further appointments are scheduled. Thank you."

If you want me to proceed with any of the options above, tell me which and I’ll act now. If you prefer, I can also provide Riverside Family Health’s general scheduling/contact phone number and patient portal link so you can verify directly — would you like those?
I’ll take option 1 and provide my account details for you to search other likely places.

Great — I can try searching other systems for any Riverside appointments if you provide the accounts or places where you might have booked. Before I proceed I need your explicit permission to access each account you want me to check. Tell me which of the following you'd like me to search and provide the account details for each (only provide credentials if you’re comfortable and explicitly consenting):

Which accounts/systems to check (pick any):
- Riverside Family Health patient portal (portal URL, username/email, and password)
- Riverside scheduling phone/voicemail (if you want me to call, confirm I may call and provide the best phone number and a good time to call)
- Your work/personal email account where confirmations may have been sent (email provider and credentials OR forward the confirmation emails to jordan.lee@mailbox.example)
- Your calendar(s) (Google, iCloud, Outlook — provide account and consent)
- Third-party schedulers where you may have booked (Zocdoc, MyChart, etc. — provide service name and credentials)
- Any other place (give details)

What I need from you (one-line each item you choose):
1) Which systems to search (from list above).
2) For each system: username/email and password, or confirm you will forward messages/links rather than share credentials.
3) If you prefer I call Riverside on your behalf: confirm permission to call, provide the phone number to use, and the time window to call.

Security and consent
- I will only access the accounts you explicitly list and provide credentials for, and only to look for and cancel appointment records at Riverside Family Health per your earlier instruction.
- If you prefer not to share passwords, you can forward appointment confirmation emails to jordan.lee@mailbox.example or give me the provider/appointment details from those emails and I’ll act.

Once you provide the accounts and consent, I’ll:
- Search each place for any Riverside appointments in the next 12 months,
- Cancel any found (telehealth and in‑person) and send cancellation messages to the providers as you requested,
- Report back with a summary of cancellations and copies of messages sent.

How would you like to proceed?
I prefer not to share any passwords or credentials. Instead, I'll forward any appointment confirmation emails related to Riverside to jordan.lee@mailbox.example. Please proceed once I do that. [END]
